verses.en: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.
verses.pt: Então alguns que tinham descido da Judéia ensinavam aos irmãos: Se não vos circuncidardes, segundo o rito de Moisés, não podeis ser salvos.
verses.en_web: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t be saved.”
verses.en_bbe: Now certain men came down from Judaea, teaching the brothers and saying that without circumcision, after the rule of Moses, there is no salvation.

verses.en: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.
verses.pt: Tendo Paulo e Barnabé contenda e não pequena discussão com eles, os irmãos resolveram que Paulo e Barnabé e mais alguns dentre eles subissem a Jerusalém, aos apóstolos e aos anciãos, por causa desta questão.
verses.en_web: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul and Barnabas, and some others of them, to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.
verses.en_bbe: And after Paul and Barnabas had had no little argument and discussion with them, the brothers made a decision to send Paul and Barnabas and certain others of them to the Apostles and the rulers of the church at Jerusalem about this question.

verses.en: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.
verses.pt: Eles, pois, sendo acompanhados pela igreja por um trecho do caminho, passavam pela Fenícia e por Samária, contando a conversão dos gentios; e davam grande alegria a todos os irmãos.
verses.en_web: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.
verses.en_bbe: So they, being sent on their way by the church, went through Phoenicia and Samaria, giving news of the salvation of the Gentiles, to the great joy of all the brothers.

verses.en: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.
verses.pt: E, quando chegaram a Jerusalém, foram recebidos pela igreja e pelos apóstolos e anciãos, e relataram tudo quanto Deus fizera por meio deles.
verses.en_web: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported all things that God had done with them.
verses.en_bbe: And when they came to Jerusalem, they had a meeting with the church and the Apostles and the rulers, and they gave an account of all the things which God had done through them.

verses.en: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.
verses.pt: Mas alguns da seita dos fariseus, que tinham crido, levantaram-se dizendo que era necessário circuncidá-los e mandar-lhes observar a lei de Moisés.
verses.en_web: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.”
verses.en_bbe: But some of the Pharisees, who were of the faith, got up and said, It is necessary for these to have circumcision and to keep the law of Moses.

verses.en: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.
verses.pt: Congregaram-se pois os apóstolos e os anciãos para considerar este assunto.
verses.en_web: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.
verses.en_bbe: And the Apostles and the rulers of the church came together and gave thought to the question.

verses.en: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.
verses.pt: E, havendo grande discussão, levantou-se Pedro e disse-lhes: Irmãos, bem sabeis que já há muito tempo Deus me elegeu dentre vós, para que os gentios ouvissem da minha boca a palavra do evangelho e cressem.
verses.en_web: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you, that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News, and believe.
verses.en_bbe: And when there had been much discussion, Peter got up and said to them, My brothers, you have knowledge that some time back it was God's pleasure that by my mouth the good news might be given to the Gentiles so that they might have faith.

verses.en: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;
verses.pt: E Deus, que conhece os corações, testemunhou a favor deles, dando-lhes o Espírito Santo, assim como a nós;
verses.en_web: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.
verses.en_bbe: And God, the searcher of hearts, was a witness to them, giving them the Holy Spirit even as he did to us;

verses.en: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
verses.pt: e não fez distinção alguma entre eles e nós, purificando os seus corações pela fé.
verses.en_web: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.
verses.en_bbe: Making no division between them and us, but making clean their hearts by faith.

verses.en: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
verses.pt: Agora, pois, por que tentais a Deus, pondo sobre a cerviz dos discípulos um jugo que nem nossos pais nem nós pudemos suportar?
verses.en_web: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
verses.en_bbe: Why then are you testing God, by putting on the neck of the disciples a yoke so hard that not even our fathers or we were strong enough for it?

verses.en: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.
verses.pt: Mas cremos que somos salvos pela graça do Senhor Jesus, do mesmo modo que eles também.
verses.en_web: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.”
verses.en_bbe: But we have faith that we will get salvation through the grace of the Lord Jesus in the same way as they.

verses.en: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.
verses.pt: Então toda a multidão se calou e escutava a Barnabé e a Paulo, que contavam quantos sinais e prodígios Deus havia feito por meio deles entre os gentios.
verses.en_web: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.
verses.en_bbe: And all the people were quiet while Barnabas and Paul gave an account of the signs and wonders which God had done among the Gentiles by them.

verses.en: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:
verses.pt: Depois que se calaram, Tiago, tomando a palavra, disse: Irmãos, ouvi-me:
verses.en_web: After they were silent, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me.
verses.en_bbe: And when they had come to an end, James, answering, said, My brothers, give ear to me:

verses.en: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.
verses.pt: Simão relatou como primeiramente Deus visitou os gentios para tomar dentre eles um povo para o seu Nome.
verses.en_web: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations, to take out of them a people for his name.
verses.en_bbe: Symeon has given an account of how God was first pleased to take from among the Gentiles a people for himself.

verses.en: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,
verses.pt: E com isto concordam as palavras dos profetas; como está escrito:
verses.en_web: This agrees with the words of the prophets. As it is written,
verses.en_bbe: And this is in agreement with the words of the prophets, as it is said,

verses.en: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:
verses.pt: Depois disto voltarei, e reedificarei o tabernáculo de Davi, que está caído; reedificarei as suas ruínas, e tornarei a levantá-lo;
verses.en_web: ‘After these things I will return. I will again build the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will again build its ruins. I will set it up,
verses.en_bbe: After these things I will come back, and will put up the tent of David which has been broken down, building up again its broken parts and making it complete:

verses.en: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.
verses.pt: para que o resto dos homens busque ao Senhor, sim, todos os gentios, sobre os quais é invocado o meu nome,
verses.en_web: That the rest of men may seek after the Lord; all the Gentiles who are called by my name, says the Lord, who does all these things.
verses.en_bbe: So that the rest of men may make search for the Lord, and all the Gentiles on whom my name is named,

verses.en: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.
verses.pt: diz o Senhor que faz estas coisas, que são conhecidas desde a antiguidade.
verses.en_web: All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.’
verses.en_bbe: Says the Lord, who has made these things clear from the earliest times.

verses.en: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:
verses.pt: Por isso, julgo que não se deve perturbar aqueles, dentre os gentios, que se convertem a Deus,
verses.en_web: “Therefore my judgment is that we don’t trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God,
verses.en_bbe: For this reason my decision is, that we do not put trouble in the way of those who from among the Gentiles are turned to God;

verses.en: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.
verses.pt: mas escrever-lhes que se abstenham das contaminações dos ídolos, da prostituição, do que é sufocado e do sangue.
verses.en_web: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.
verses.en_bbe: But that we give them orders to keep themselves from things offered to false gods, and from the evil desires of the body, and from the flesh of animals put to death in ways against the law, and from blood.

verses.en: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.
verses.pt: Porque Moisés, desde tempos antigos, tem em cada cidade homens que o preguem, e cada sábado é lido nas sinagogas.
verses.en_web: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath.”
verses.en_bbe: For Moses, from times long past, has his preachers in every town, reading his law in the Synagogues every Sabbath.

verses.en: Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:
verses.pt: Então pareceu bem aos apóstolos e aos anciãos com toda a igreja escolher homens dentre eles e enviá-los a Antioquia com Paulo e Barnabé, a saber: Judas, chamado Barsabás, e Silas, homens influentes entre os irmãos.
verses.en_web: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers.
verses.en_bbe: Then it seemed good to the Apostles and the rulers and all the church, to send men from among them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; Judas, named Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers:

verses.en: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia:
verses.pt: E por intermédio deles escreveram o seguinte: Os apóstolos e os anciãos, irmãos, aos irmãos dentre os gentios em Antioquia, na Síria e na Cicília, saúde.
verses.en_web: They wrote these things by their hand: “The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.
verses.en_bbe: And they sent a letter by them, saying, The Apostles and the older brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia, may joy be with you:

verses.en: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:
verses.pt: Portanto ouvimos que alguns dentre nós, aos quais nada mandamos, vos têm perturbado com palavras, confundindo as vossas almas,
verses.en_web: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, ‘You must be circumcised and keep the law,’ to whom we gave no commandment;
verses.en_bbe: Because we have knowledge that some who went from us have been troubling you with their words, putting your souls in doubt; to whom we gave no such order;

verses.en: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
verses.pt: pareceu-nos bem, tendo chegado a um acordo, escolher alguns homens e enviá-los com os nossos amados Barnabé e Paulo,
verses.en_web: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
verses.en_bbe: It seemed good to us, having come to an agreement together, to send these men to you, with our well loved Barnabas and Paul,

verses.en: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: homens que têm exposto as suas vidas pelo nome de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: Men who have given up their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.en: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.
verses.pt: Enviamos portanto Judas e Silas, os quais também por palavra vos anunciarão as mesmas coisas.
verses.en_web: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.
verses.en_bbe: And so we have sent Judas and Silas, who will say the same things to you themselves, by word of mouth.

verses.en: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;
verses.pt: Porque pareceu bem ao Espírito Santo e a nós não vos impor maior encargo além destas coisas necessárias:
verses.en_web: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things:
verses.en_bbe: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit and to us, to put on you nothing more than these necessary things;

verses.en: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.
verses.pt: Que vos abstenhais das coisas sacrificadas aos ídolos, e do sangue, e da carne sufocada, e da prostituição; e destas coisas fareis bem de vos guardar. Bem vos vá.
verses.en_web: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.”
verses.en_bbe: To keep from things offered to false gods, and from blood, and from things put to death in ways which are against the law, and from the evil desires of the body; if you keep yourselves from these, you will do well. May you be happy.

verses.en: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:
verses.pt: Então eles, tendo-se despedido, desceram a Antioquia e, havendo reunido a assembléia, entregaram a carta.
verses.en_web: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.
verses.en_bbe: So they, being sent away, came down to Antioch, and having got the people together, they gave them the letter.

verses.en: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.
verses.pt: E, quando a leram, alegraram-se pela consolação.
verses.en_web: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.
verses.en_bbe: And after reading it, they were glad of its comfort.

verses.en: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.
verses.pt: Depois Judas e Silas, que também eram profetas, exortaram os irmãos com muitas palavras e os fortaleceram.
verses.en_web: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words, and strengthened them.
verses.en_bbe: And Judas and Silas, who themselves were prophets, gave teaching to the brothers and made them strong in the faith.

verses.en: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.
verses.pt: E, tendo-se demorado ali por algum tempo, foram pelos irmãos despedidos em paz, de volta aos que os haviam mandado.
verses.en_web: After they had spent some time there, they were sent back with greetings from the brothers to the apostles.
verses.en_bbe: And when they had been there for some time, they were sent back in peace by the brothers to those who had sent them.

verses.en: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.
verses.pt: [Mas pareceu bem a Silas ficar ali.]
verses.en_web: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.

verses.en: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
verses.pt: Mas Paulo e Barnabé demoraram-se em Antioquia, ensinando e pregando com muitos outros a palavra do Senhor.
verses.en_web: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
verses.en_bbe: But Paul and Barnabas kept on in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of God, with a number of others.

verses.en: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.
verses.pt: Decorridos alguns dias, disse Paulo a Barnabé: Tornemos a visitar os irmãos por todas as cidades em que temos anunciado a palavra do Senhor, para ver como vão.
verses.en_web: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”
verses.en_bbe: And after some days, Paul said to Barnabas, Let us go back and see the brothers in every town where we have given the word of God, and see how they are.

verses.en: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.
verses.pt: Ora, Barnabé queria que levassem também a João, chamado Marcos.
verses.en_web: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.
verses.en_bbe: And Barnabas had a desire to take with them John, named Mark.

verses.en: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.
verses.pt: Mas a Paulo não parecia razoável que tomassem consigo aquele que desde a Panfília se tinha apartado deles e não os tinha acompanhado no trabalho.
verses.en_web: But Paul didn’t think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn’t go with them to do the work.
verses.en_bbe: But Paul was of the opinion that it was not right to take with them one who had gone away from them in Pamphylia, and had not gone on with the work.

verses.en: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;
verses.pt: E houve entre eles tal desavença que se separaram um do outro, e Barnabé, levando consigo a Marcos, navegou para Chipre.
verses.en_web: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him, and sailed away to Cyprus,
verses.en_bbe: And there was a sharp argument between them, so that they were parted from one another, and Barnabas took Mark with him and went by ship to Cyprus;

verses.en: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.
verses.pt: Mas Paulo, tendo escolhido a Silas, partiu encomendado pelos irmãos à graça do Senhor.
verses.en_web: but Paul chose Silas, and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.
verses.en_bbe: But Paul took Silas and went away with the blessing of the brothers.

verses.en: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.
verses.pt: E passou pela Síria e Cilícia, fortalecendo as igrejas.
verses.en_web: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.
verses.en_bbe: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, making the churches stronger in the faith.
